descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S05 「现成的 spec：养老院 Medications 面板从查房前和从就诊来，以及记录里暂停的用药事实」 Existing spec: Nursing Home Medications panel from the pre-round and from the visit, and the note's held-medication facts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 Nursing Home has its own Medications panel, filled from the pre-round (PR #56).（UAT TC-19 ER 9；TFA-92597 AC 3）
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated.（UAT TC-19 ER 9；TFA-92597 R5）
  • U10 Same drug in two forms → two rows; brand/generic → one row.（UAT TC-19 ER 7；TFA-92597 R8；TFA-94229 R6）
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-19 Steps；UAT 3.3）
  • T4 A restarted or resumed medication no longer shows stale 'held' language, on the tracker or in the note.（TFA-94655 AC 3）
  • U2 The generated note's plan and medication section reflect the tracker: held and stopped drugs are surfaced from the tracker rows, not from older notes or a regex over them.（UAT TC-19；TFA-92597 AC 4；TFA-94655 AC 1）
  • T5 A long-standing Nursing Home hold (e.g. metformin) still displays correctly months later.（TFA-94655 AC 4）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Nursing Home resident; pre-round parse and visit extraction answered at the socket

When Pre-round Save Note with parsed medications; with a held drug the model calls active; with a new drug sharing a word with a row on file; Generate Note & Finish with a hold dictated only at the visit, and with a restart dictated only at the visit; …

Then Parsed medications reach the Nursing Home panel; the held drug stays Held with its date; the new drug gets its own row; a visit hold holds the row with today's date and the dictated reason; a visit restart ends the hold (active, resumed, today); …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions on the saved rows and the 'Held · <date>' tag after reload. Code layer only. The held-medication test covers TFA-94655 AC 1 and the input side of AC 4 (a six-month-old Nursing Home hold still reaches the note); what the note says is S25

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
